questions.question: Which one is correct ?[]

questions.question: The <u>charity</u> of Hatem Tai is known to all. The word 'Charity' is ---[]
questions.explanation: (The + Abstract Noun + of), it is categorized as a Common Noun.

questions.question: They praised the 'honesty' of the girl. Here the word (honesty) is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation: (The + Abstract Noun + of), it is categorized as a Common Noun.

questions.question:
He is a justice of the High Court. The word 'Justice' is 
a/an ----- noun.[]
questions.explanation: (a/The + Abstract Noun + of), it is categorized as a Common Noun.

questions.question: Drive the nail into the table. 'Nail' শব্দটি কোন প্রকারের noun ?[]
questions.explanation: যেসব নাম দিয়ে একই জাতীয় ব্যক্তি, বস্তু বা প্রাণীকে সাধারণভাবে বোঝানো হয়, সেগুলোই Common Noun। যেমন: Table, Pen, Chair, এবং Nail।

questions.question: The 'rice' of Dinajpur is fine. The word 'rice' in the sentence is a ---[]
questions.explanation: (The + Material Noun + of), it acts as a Common Noun.

questions.question: The class consists of twenty public. The word 'public' is an example of ---[]
questions.explanation: public = people (general) → Common noun

questions.question: There are ten classes in our school. What kind of noun is the word 'class' ?[]
questions.explanation:
এখানে ten classes = আলাদা আলাদা class
নির্দিষ্ট কোনো নাম না
group হিসেবে একক ধরা হয়নি
তাই Common noun
(Collective তখনই হবে: The class is noisy — একদল ছাত্র)

questions.question: Which one of the following is an example of proper noun ?[]
questions.explanation:
the police ❌ → common/collective
car ❌ → common noun
Bangladesh ✅ → নির্দিষ্ট দেশের নাম
family ❌ → collective/common
 Trick:
✔ Proper noun = নির্দিষ্ট নাম + Capital letter

questions.explanation:
যা ৫ ইন্দ্রিয় দিয়ে ধরা যায় না (দেখা/শোনা/ছোঁয়া যায় না)
✅ Abstract noun
 Trick:
love, honesty, fear, pain → Abstract noun

questions.explanation:

 Trick:
archipelago = দ্বীপপুঞ্জ
geography term

questions.question: What kind of noun is 'Committee' ?[]
questions.explanation:
✅ Collective noun
Trick:
অনেক মানুষ
কিন্তু একসাথে এক unit হিসেবে ধরা
 team, committee, jury, family → Collective noun

questions.question: কোনটি Abstract noun ?[]
questions.explanation:
Abstract noun = গুণ, অবস্থা, পরিমাপ
Height = উচ্চতা (ধরা যায় না, অনুভব/মাপ বোঝায়)
❌ Long → adjective
❌ Man → common noun (মানুষ)
❌ Jury → collective noun

questions.question: Which of the following is abstract noun ?[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
 যদি শব্দের শেষে –hood, –ship, –ness, –tion, –ment থাকে → বেশিরভাগ সময় Abstract noun
Child → person (Concrete)
Boy → person (Concrete)
Family → group (Collective)
Childhood → condition/state (দেখা যায় না, ছোঁয়া যায় না)
✔ Abstract noun = idea, quality, state

questions.question: Would you like to have ----- tea ?[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
 Tea হলো uncountable noun
 “Would you like to have” মানে নির্দিষ্ট কিছু চাই
✔ Polite offer/request এ সাধারণত a cup of / a glass of / a piece of ব্যবহার হয়
a little → quantity বোঝায়
some → ঠিক আছে, কিন্তু এখানে specific serving চাইছে
a cup of → perfect and specific ✅

questions.question: নিম্নের কোনটি Abstract noun নয় ?[]
questions.explanation:
Abstract noun = যা দেখা/ছোঁয়া যায় না
Air → physical substance
Water → physical substance
Goodwill → feeling (Abstract)
Flavour → quality (Abstract)
✔ তাই Air & Water abstract না

questions.question: Iron' is a useful metal. এখানে 'Iron' শব্দটি কোন প্রকারের Noun ?[]
questions.explanation:
যেসব noun দিয়ে জিনিস তৈরি হয় → Material noun
Examples:
Gold, Silver, Wood, Iron
✔ এখানে Iron = metal substance
তাই Material noun

questions.question: Ali saw a 'flock' of sheep. বাক্যে 'flock' শব্দটি ---[]
questions.explanation:
যদি একটি শব্দ দিয়ে অনেকগুলো একই জিনিসের দল বোঝায় → Collective noun
Flock = sheep এর দল 
✔ One word + many members = Collective

questions.question: Our 'team' is better than yours. Here 'team' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Team = অনেক player মিলে এক দল
✔ Group name = Collective noun
Examples: team, army, class, jury

Sajib, America → Proper noun
Water, Milk, Steel → Material noun
Unity, Health, Poverty → Abstract noun
Cattle, Army, Class → group names → Collective ✔
 Group মানেই Collective

questions.explanation:
যা দেখা যায় না, ছোঁয়া যায় না, কিন্তু অনুভব করা যায় → Abstract

Anxious → adjective
Grand → adjective

Long (adj) → Length (quality)
✔ Quality name = Abstract

questions.question: The best word stands for Abstract noun is ---[]

Beauty = quality (দেখা যায় না, অনুভব করা যায়)
Boat, Sail, Bird → physical things

questions.question: What kind of noun is 'Journey' ?[]
questions.explanation:
Abstract noun = quality/idea (love, honesty)
∆Journey = an event/activity (you can see/experience it physically)
So it’s a Common noun, not abstract ✔
